payload.title: File:Gondwanacanthus decollatus holotype caudal fin.jpg
payload.artist_html: Alexandre Cunha Ribeiro, Diogo de Mayrinck, Flávio Alicino Bockmann and Mário de Pinna
payload.description_html: †Gondwanacanthus decollatus sp. nov., MCP3457 (holotype). A, detailed view of the caudal-fin skeletal structure. B, interpretative illustration of the caudal-fin skeletal anatomy. Abbreviations: 1–5, hypurals 1–5; Ep, epural; HsPu2, haemal spine of preural centrum 2; Ns, neural spine; NsPu2, neural spine of preural centrum 2; P.r, principal caudal rays; Phy, parhypural; Pu1, Pu2, preural centrum 1, 2; U1, U2, ural centrum 1, 2; Un1, Un2, uroneural 1, 2. Scale bars represents 5 mm.
